options: Restricting data to its owning department
Making data accessible to all the relevant stakeholders
questions.explanation: As the name says, Data Sharing is about making data accessible to all the relevant stakeholders.

questions.stem: Data Sharing is described as eliminating what?
questions.explanation: The key phrase is that Data Sharing is about eliminating Dark Data.

questions.stem: In what kind of organisation is Data Sharing a key component, and what culture does it aim to build?
options: A regulated organisation aiming for data confidentiality
A data-driven organisation aiming to build a data culture with Data Liberalisation
A start-up aiming to reduce storage
A government body aiming for data islands
A bank aiming for departmental silos
questions.explanation: Data Sharing is a key component of a Data Driven Organisation, which aims to build a data culture through Data Liberalisation.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as a Data Sharing channel?
options: Exporting in Excel, CSV or flat-file formats
questions.explanation: BI tools, connectors, file exports and ETL/ELT tools are listed channels; sending printed reports by courier is not.

questions.stem: Which languages are named as a channel for Data Sharing?
questions.explanation: Using languages like SQL and Python is one of the listed Data Sharing channels.

questions.stem: Which pair of channels describes two directions in which databases and applications can exchange data?
options: Pushing data to other databases and applications, and letting others pull data
questions.explanation: Both pushing data to other databases and applications, and letting other databases and applications pull data, are listed as sharing channels.

questions.stem: Which of these analytical approaches is listed as a channel for Data Sharing?
options: Machine Learning or Data Mining models
questions.explanation: Using Machine Learning or Data Mining models is among the Data Sharing channels.

questions.stem: Which type of report is listed as a Data Sharing channel?
questions.explanation: Audit, compliance or regulatory reports are among the ways data is shared.

questions.stem: Which of these connection technologies appear in the Data Sharing channels list?
questions.explanation: Using APIs and using built-in drivers are both listed as channels for sharing data.

questions.stem: Which file formats are named as export options for Data Sharing?
questions.explanation: Exporting in Excel, CSV and FF (flat file) formats is one of the listed Data Sharing channels.
